title: Column: Beyond lithium and rare earths, fluorspar is a hidden chokepoint for chip production
content: Debate over critical minerals has centered on metals and metalloids such as lithium, cobalt, rare earths, graphite, gallium, and germanium, as if geopolitical rivalry played out only in battery electrodes and chip epitaxial materials. A less visible but equally fragile supply chain sits behind semiconductor manufacturing: the fluorochemical chain that starts with fluorspar, a mineral composed mainly of calcium fluoride (CaF2).

title: Samsung hesitates to take on Nvidia in robot chips
content: South Korea asked Samsung Electronics in October to develop a domestic alternative to Nvidia's Jetson Thor robotics computing platform, but the chipmaker expressed reservations over market demand, South Korean broadcaster MTN reported, citing a government official.

title: LG AI Research targets data and model bottlenecks in smart manufacturing
content: LG AI Research is automating data preparation, building expert foundation models, and setting up an autonomous laboratory to ease the burden on companies that want to deploy AI and keep using it, particularly in manufacturing.
